text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... It's perfect... A magical drink to clear the mind...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Chameleon plant herbal tea, chocolate that's good for the brain, and sweet orange juice as the base! It's a super-effective combination!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If I drink this, it should polish
my genius magic to even greater heights...!

Sweep Tosho didn't seem to be feeling well,
so I decided to let her rest in the Trainer's room for a while...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uuugh…… My head hurts soooo much…….
choice_data_list: Any idea what it could be?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...S-Shut up! It's magical interference,
magical interference! Magical girls always
have to deal with these kinds of troubles!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "I wonder if that drink really was a mistake after all...?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, my head hurts so I'm resting todayyyy!
Familiar, fetch me a fluffy futon right nowwww!

And so, Sweep Tosho found herself
plagued by a headache...
